description: List the Hindu festivals and sankrantis that fall in one calendar month of a year (2020-2040), sorted by date; may be empty. Use for questions like 'festivals in October 2026'. Do NOT use for the whole year (use list_festivals) or the next one (use next_festival).
name: festivals_in_month

festivals.description: Festivals in that month, sorted by date (may be empty).

about.description: Short meaning and the lunar or solar rule that fixes the date.

date.description: Computed Gregorian date, YYYY-MM-DD (approximate, +/-1 day at tithi edges).

month.description: Amanta lunar month name in effect on that date, e.g. Ashwin.

name.description: Festival name, e.g. "Diwali / Lakshmi Puja" or "Makara Sankranti / Pongal".

tithi.description: Lunar day index at IST noon on that date, 0-29 (0 = Shukla Pratipada, 29 = Amavasya), as 'index N'.

month.description: The calendar month that was searched, 1-12.

title: Festivals in month
